title: cystium agninum
intro: Cystium agninum, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a perennial flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as skin conditions, wounds, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Marigold are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ranunculin, protoanemonin, and isorhapontigenin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
